# Latvia Lauki Parcels

Latvia field boundaries (2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Rural Support Service Republic of Latvia (Lauku atbalsta dienests). License: CC-BY-SA-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lv/latest/lv.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/lv/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:3059; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: collection, hcat:name_en, id, block_id, crop:code, metrics:area, metrics:perimeter, geometry, hcat:code, hcat:name, crop:name, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lv/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lv/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lv/collection.json
